ruleDefinitions.name: Windows Network Access Suspicious desktop.ini Action
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects unusual processes accessing desktop.ini remotely over network share, which can be leveraged to alter how Explorer displays a folder's content (i.e. renaming files) without changing them on disk. Note: Unmapped fields: ObjectType, RelativeTargetName, AccessList

sequences.query: (event_id = 5145 AND ObjectType = "File" AND RelativeTargetName = RGX("\\\\desktop\\\.ini$") AND (AccessList = RGX(".*WriteData.*") OR AccessList = RGX(".*DELETE.*") OR AccessList = RGX(".*WriteDAC.*") OR AccessList = RGX(".*AppendData.*") OR AccessList = RGX(".*AddSubdirectory.*")))
